summary: SDK bundle triggers generic HTTP/dyndns keyword patterns without traced exfiltration
details: The package ships a bundled dist/index.js implementing a semantic-indexer SDK. Static keyword scans matched on the presence of multiple POST calls and the substring 'dyndns' within the minified bundle, but no traced code path shows installer-side secrets being read or sent to an attacker-controlled destination. The POST call sites and the 'dyndns' token appear in the shape typical of an SDK bundle (documented API endpoints and third-party library string tables carried through minification), not in the shape of a hardcoded C2 or exfiltration path. No install-time or import-time network fetch, no credential-path reads (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser stores), no obfuscated destination reconstruction, and no lifecycle scripts performing outbound network activity are present.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
